name: What are the signs of a rotted window frame that I should look for?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of a rotted window frame that I should look for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a rotted window frame include discoloration or darkening of the wood, soft or spongy areas when poked, visible cracks or crumbling wood, and a musty odor. You might also notice peeling paint, increased draftiness around the window, or difficulty operating the window itself. If you suspect rot, a thorough inspection by a professional can confirm the extent of the damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for discoloration, soft or spongy wood, visible cracks, musty odors, peeling paint, or increased drafts as signs of rotted window frames.
